You can return by train from the towns of the Riviera di Levante in Liguria where you decide to end the walk. In particular:

  • Recco, Camogli and Santa Margherita Ligure have a railway station.
  • Portofino Mare has no railway station, but the one at Santa Margherita Ligure can be reached in about an hour and a quarter on foot (via a woodland path to Paraggi and then along the seafront), or in 25 minutes by bus on line 782 (check the timetable on the website of the transport company AMT Genova), or, at a pinch, by ferry on line 1 (check the timetable on the Servizio Marittimo del Tigullio website). If you care about the integrity of your estate, avoid the Portofino taxis.

For more tailor-made solutions – e.g. joining or leaving the path at Casanova or Uscio – consult the local transport companies; we warn you in advance, however, that you will need a good deal of creativity to make up for the general lack of viable alternatives.
